title: NGINX UI plugin catalog
description: The static catalog document a host fetches from a marketplace source, schema_version 1, including per-platform downloads and the publisher members. Packages carry their own signature, so a release names none; signature_url and signed_by of older catalogs are ignored. See https://nginxui.com/plugin/catalog. The reference host reads it in internal/plugin/marketplace.go. Unknown members are ignored by a host, so the schema allows them.

schema_version.description: The only catalog layout defined so far. Adding downloads did not change it: a host that does not know downloads still reads download_url.

name.description: The name of the catalog a host shows for this source, locale code to text, en is the fallback.

icon.description: A square image that stands for the catalog, loaded under the same rules as screenshots.

platformKey.description: <goos>-<goarch> as Go spells them, or any.

localized.description: Locale code to text, en is the fallback.

dark_url.description: The same view in the dark theme; hosts show url when it is absent.

author_public_key.description: Minisign public key (the base64 line of a .pub file) the author signs the packages of this entry with. A package downloaded from this entry and signed with it is community.

screenshots.description: Images of the plugin in use, in display order.

trust.description: Informational label for listing and filtering. A host derives the level of a package from its signer and never grants one from this member.

stage.description: Maturity shown next to the plugin, e.g. production or beta. Display only, release channels are set per release.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the package file, a check of the download.

version.description: Semantic version, equal to the version of every package of the release.

platforms.description: Summary of where the release installs: every key of downloads plus the platforms the portable package serves. Empty or absent means the portable package runs everywhere.

downloads.description: Per-platform packages, keyed by <goos>-<goarch> or any. A host picks downloads[platform], then downloads[any], then the portable package.

download_url.description: The portable package, the fallback for every platform downloads does not name. May be empty when downloads is present.

notes.description: What changed in the release, in Markdown. A host sanitizes the rendered HTML and links to release_notes_url for the full notes.

channel.description: The release channel, from the most to the least stable. Without it the host infers the channel from the version: no prerelease part is stable, a prerelease starting with alpha, dev, nightly, snapshot, canary or preview is dev, any other prerelease is beta.

manifest.description: Snapshot of the release manifest, whose server.executables names every platform the release ships.
